items.title: Which ecosystem and protected-area records contain Burmese text-quality issues?
assumptions: Confirmed findings are limited to high-confidence visible misspellings, duplicated characters, and duplicated words or phrases.
Specific words using non-standard ဥ် are reported separately from obvious visible typos.
Canonically equivalent Unicode forms such as ဦး/ဦး are excluded from spelling-error counts.
Ambiguous terminology variants such as အိမ်ယာ/အိမ်ရာ and ဒဟက်/ဒဟတ် are review candidates, not confirmed errors.

source.label: Wildlife ecosystem source data
caveats: Automated and manual pattern review can identify high-confidence issues but cannot prove every free-text sentence is linguistically perfect.
No ecosystem source record was modified.

evidenceFlow.title: Ecosystem JSON

evidenceFlow.title: Burmese text-quality checks
evidenceFlow.detail: The review checked repeated code points, repeated words or phrases, curated high-confidence spelling patterns, and specific non-standard ဥ် spellings.
